priority_updates.title: If the Boston Celtics agree to trade Jaylen Brown by July 31, 2026, which NBA team will be his destination?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Reporting by ESPN or The Associated Press identifying an agreed trade involving Jaylen Brown between June 1 and July 31, 2026. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the team designated to receive Brown under the first such publicly reported agreement. An agreement counts even if league approval or completion remains pending. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the NBA team.

priority_updates.title: Which month will the Palestinian Football Association announce for the resumption of its football competitions after their October 2023 suspension?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official Palestinian Football Association announcement, or reliable news reporting quoting its leadership. Resolution Conditions : Use the first public announcement between July 1 and August 31, 2026, that specifies a date for restarting the suspended football competitions. Resolve to the calendar month containing that announced restart date, regardless of whether competitions subsequently begin as scheduled. If no qualifying announcement occurs by the deadline, the question is void. Accepted Answer Format : The full English name of the month, not the month in which the announcement is made.

priority_updates.title: Which Russian official will the Kremlin publicly confirm as attending Ali Khamenei's state funeral?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the Russian official whose planned attendance at Ali Khamenei's state funeral is publicly confirmed by the Kremlin. Use the Kremlin's announcement or reliable reporting of it. This question concerns the announcement, not actual attendance. Resolution Date : 2026-07-02 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the official's full name.

priority_updates.title: Which national team will win the Boston quarterfinal at the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : FIFA's official match result, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting. Resolution Date : Resolve when the quarterfinal scheduled for Boston on July 9, 2026, concludes. Accepted Answer Format : Provide the winning national team's name. If the match requires a penalty shootout, the shootout winner counts as the winner.

Resolution : Resolve to the country whose national team wins the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup final, scheduled for July 19, 2026. A victory after extra time or a penalty shootout counts as winning the final. Accepted Answer Format : The country's common English name.

Resolution : Resolve to the winner of the third-place playoff, scheduled for July 18, 2026, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.

priority_updates.title: Which NBA team will sign Trey Alexander to a two-way contract in the first two weeks of July 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : as confirmed by a team announcement or contemporaneous sports reporting Resolution Date : Resolve to the NBA team that signs Trey Alexander to a two-way contract between July 1 and July 14, 2026, inclusive Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the team's full name.

priority_updates.title: Which U.S. state will have the highest reported cyclospora case count by July 16, 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The latest CDC state-level data publicly available on July 16, 2026, reporting the cumulative number of cyclospora infections reported during 2026 Resolution Date : 2026-07-16 Accepted Answer Format : String (name of the U.S. state)

priority_updates.title: With which country will the United States record its largest trade deficit in May 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve using the country-level trade balances in the initial May 2026 trade report from the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and Census Bureau. Identify the individual country associated with the largest U.S. trade deficit, excluding regional groupings. Resolution Date : 2026-07-07 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the country's common English name.

priority_updates.title: Which UK party leader will announce plans in early July 2026 to resign as an MP and contest the resulting by-election?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public announcements corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from BBC News, The Guardian, or Al Jazeera. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the UK political party leader who publicly announces, between July 1 and July 9, 2026, plans to resign from the House of Commons and stand in the by-election caused by that resignation. The announcement is sufficient; the by-election need not have taken place. Accepted Answer Format : The party leader's full name.

priority_updates.title: Which country will win the 2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official tournament final result published by the International Cricket Council, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution : Resolve when the winner of the 2026 tournament is established by the final's official result. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.

priority_updates.title: Who will be named Player of the Tournament at the 2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The International Cricket Council's official announcement of the Player of the Tournament for the 2026 Women's T20 World Cup. Resolution Condition : Resolve when the recipient of the tournament-wide award is officially announced, rather than any individual match award. Accepted Answer Format : The recipient's full name.

priority_updates.title: What principal criminal penalty will Hannah Dugan receive at her initial sentencing for obstructing a federal proceeding?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The federal court’s sentencing judgment or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the sentence announced in court. Resolution Conditions : Resolve when the federal district court first imposes a sentence for Dugan’s obstruction conviction. Identify the principal criminal penalty imposed at that sentencing. Subsequent appeals or resentencing do not change the answer. Accepted Answer Format : A short noun phrase naming the principal criminal penalty.

priority_updates.title: Who will Moldova’s parliament elect as prime minister to succeed Alexandru Munteanu?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Moldovan parliamentary announcements or reliable news reporting confirming the election of a new prime minister. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first person elected prime minister by Moldova’s parliament following Alexandru Munteanu’s resignation. A nomination or temporary appointment as acting prime minister does not qualify. Resolution Date : The date parliament elects the successor. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the person elected.

priority_updates.title: Which company will hold the record for the largest US IPO by a foreign firm as of July 10, 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official issuer announcements and contemporaneous reporting by reputable news organizations. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the company reported as holding the all-time record for the largest US initial public offering by a foreign company as of July 10, 2026. Compare offerings by proceeds raised, not company valuation. An offering whose pricing and share sales have been announced may qualify before exchange trading begins. Accepted Answer Format : The company's commonly used name.

priority_updates.title: Which team will win the England–India T20 international series in July 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official match results or contemporaneous AFP reporting identifying the winner of the England–India T20 international series in July 2026. Resolution Timing : Resolve when a team secures an unassailable series lead, or when the series concludes if its winner has not previously been determined. Accepted Answer Format : The country name of the series-winning team.

priority_updates.title: Who will be the first player to reach the men's singles final at Wimbledon in 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the winner of the first men's singles semifinal completed at the 2026 Wimbledon Championships, according to the tournament's official match results. Resolution Date : 2026-07-10 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the player's full name.

priority_updates.title: Who will win the women's singles title at Wimbledon in 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official Wimbledon results identifying the 2026 women's singles champion. Resolution Date : The question resolves when the tournament officially confirms the winner of the 2026 women's singles final. Accepted Answer Format : The winning player's name.

priority_updates.title: Which ownership group will receive NFL owners' approval to buy the Seattle Seahawks in 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official NFL announcement or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the purchasing group approved by NFL owners. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the purchasing ownership group in the first sale of the Seattle Seahawks formally approved by NFL owners during 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the purchasing group or the family leading it.

priority_updates.title: Who will win the men's singles title at Wimbledon in 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The champion recorded in Wimbledon's official results for the 2026 men's singles tournament. Resolution Date : Resolve when the men's singles final, scheduled for July 12, 2026, is completed and the winner is officially confirmed. Accepted Answer Format : The winning player's full name.

priority_updates.title: Which U.S. state will be the first to impose a statewide moratorium on construction of large new hyperscale data centres?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Qualifying Event : Resolve to the first U.S. state to formally impose, by December 31, 2026, a statewide temporary moratorium on construction or permitting of large new hyperscale data centres. Proposed legislation, vetoed measures, and restrictions limited to individual municipalities do not qualify. Source of Truth : Official state-government announcements, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution occurs when the qualifying moratorium is publicly announced as imposed. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the state.

priority_updates.title: Which national team will win the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup semifinal in Atlanta?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : FIFA's official match result or reliable contemporary reporting of the semifinal scheduled for July 15, 2026, in Atlanta. Resolution : Resolve to the national team that wins this semifinal and advances to the final, including victory after extra time or a penalty shootout if required. Accepted Answer Format : The country's name.

priority_updates.title: Which Gaza locality will be the site of the deadliest Israeli strike reported on July 17, 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Al Jazeera's July 17, 2026 reporting on that day's attacks across Gaza. Compare individual strikes rather than cumulative deaths across separate attacks. Resolution Date : 2026-07-17 Accepted Answer Format : Resolve to the city, town, or refugee camp where the individual Israeli strike with the highest reported death toll occurred. Answer with the locality's name.

local_articles.title: Israeli strike kills two, setting tents ablaze in Gaza humanitarian zone
local_articles.snippet: Two people were killed and several others were injured after an Israeli strike hit the Mawasi area of Khan Younis, a zone previously designated by Israel as a humanitarian area in the southern Gaza Strip. A total of five people were killed across Gaza on Monday.

priority_updates.title: If Morgan Rogers leaves Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement from either club confirming a completed permanent transfer, corroborated by reputable sports reporting. Resolution Conditions : Conditional on Rogers completing a permanent transfer away from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window, resolve to the acquiring club. If he completes multiple transfers during the window, use his first permanent transfer from Aston Villa. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the acquiring football club.

priority_updates.title: Who will win the Golden Boot at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : FIFA's official announcement of the 2026 World Cup Golden Boot winner. Resolution Date : Resolve upon confirmation of the award winner at the conclusion of the tournament, whose final is scheduled for July 19, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the player officially awarded the Golden Boot, rather than the Silver Boot or Bronze Boot.

priority_updates.title: Which player will win the Golden Ball at the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : FIFA's official announcement of the 2026 men's World Cup tournament awards. Resolution : Resolve to the player officially awarded the Golden Ball at the conclusion of the tournament, whose final is scheduled for July 19, 2026. This is the tournament-wide award, not an individual match award. Accepted Answer Format : The player's name or established professional name.

priority_updates.title: Which country will the Trump administration target in its first invocation of Section 338 tariff powers by August 18, 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the country whose exports are targeted by the Trump administration's first invocation of Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, announced on or before August 18, 2026. An announced tariff measure counts even if its effective date has not yet arrived. Use official U.S. announcements or contemporaneous reporting confirming the invocation. Resolution Date : 2026-08-18 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the country's common English name.

priority_updates.title: Which country will win the men's team gymnastics gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Commonwealth Games results, corroborated by contemporary reliable news reporting. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the country awarded gold in the men's team gymnastics competition at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, once the final standings are announced. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.

priority_updates.title: Which club will Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha join after Chaves in 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official club or player announcement, or reliable contemporaneous sports reporting confirming a completed move. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the first club Vozinha joins after leaving Chaves in 2026. Offers, negotiations, and proposed transfers do not count. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the club.

priority_updates.title: Which NBA team will LeBron James choose for the 2026–27 season?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : James's public announcement of his team choice for the 2026–27 season during the 2026 offseason, corroborated by reputable news or sports reporting. Resolution Date : Resolve when James publicly announces that choice. A completed contract signing or appearance in a game is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the NBA team he chooses.

priority_updates.title: Which club will sign Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig in summer 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement by RB Leipzig or the destination club confirming an agreement for Diomande's permanent transfer. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the destination club in the first such agreement announced between June 1 and August 31, 2026. Loan agreements do not count. Accepted Answer Format : The commonly used name of the destination club.

priority_updates.title: Which country will agree to a joint project with Iran to clear sea mines from the Strait of Hormuz by August 26, 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the country that agrees with Iran to a joint mine-clearance project in the Strait of Hormuz, as announced in a statement from the two governments by August 26, 2026. Resolution Date : 2026-08-26 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the country's common English name.

priority_updates.title: Which country's mainland coastline will be confirmed contaminated by the Caroline Bezengi oil spill by August 13, 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public statements by government environmental authorities, or reliable news reports directly citing those statements. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the country whose mainland coastline is confirmed to have been contaminated by oil from the Caroline Bezengi by August 13, 2026. Offshore pollution, contamination confined to islands, and predictions of future landfall do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The country's name.

priority_updates.title: If Fabinho moves to a new club during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official club announcements or regulatory filings confirming Fabinho’s signing. Resolution Rule : Resolve to the first new club officially confirmed as signing Fabinho on a permanent contract between June 1 and September 30, 2026, regardless of his previous contractual status. Loans do not qualify. If no qualifying signing is announced during this period, the question is void. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the destination club.

priority_updates.title: Which club will sign Nicolas Jackson on a permanent transfer from Chelsea during the summer 2026 transfer window?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement by the buying or selling club, or reliable news reporting confirming a completed permanent transfer. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the club that completes Jackson's permanent signing from Chelsea during the summer 2026 transfer window. Loan arrangements, reported interest, negotiations, and agreements that remain uncompleted do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The club's commonly used name.

priority_updates.title: Which player will command the highest transfer fee paid by a Premier League club during the 2026 summer transfer window?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve using Al Jazeera Sport's reporting of completed transfers after England's 2026 summer transfer window closes. The answer is the player whose transfer fee, expressed in pounds sterling, is the highest paid by a Premier League club during that window. Exclude proposed or failed transfers. Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.

priority_updates.title: Who will score the opening goal when Real Betis host Real Madrid in La Liga in September 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : La Liga's official match record, corroborated by reliable match reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the player credited with the earliest goal in the September 2026 La Liga fixture hosted by Real Betis against Real Madrid. Disallowed goals do not count. If the match finishes goalless, resolve as “No goalscorer.” Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.

priority_updates.title: Which club will lead the La Liga table immediately after the Valencia–Barcelona match scheduled for September 20, 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official La Liga standings or reputable contemporaneous match reports. Resolution : Resolve to the club occupying first place in the La Liga table immediately after the completion of Valencia's home match against Barcelona scheduled for September 20, 2026. Use the league's official ranking rules if clubs are level on points. Accepted Answer Format : Return the name of the first-placed club.

priority_updates.title: Which club, if any, will win the La Liga Madrid derby on September 20, 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official La Liga match result, corroborated by reliable news coverage. Resolution : Resolve according to the final score, including stoppage time, of the Madrid derby scheduled for September 20, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : Return the winning club's name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.
